security_privacy_cost_impact: None in the tree: two decision records, no role, credential, grant, policy or migration. RFC-2026-028 proposes a login role with no password in any migration, a verifier set out of band from the platform secret store in a secret scope no request-path runtime can read, at least 32 random bytes, and a generated per-cluster test credential; on the provisioned instance the migration owner holds ADMIN on the role and so can set its credential (recorded, Q-028-13). No secret is written anywhere by this batch (secret scan green). RFC-2026-023 proposes widening app_authz by five columns and one own-rows policy on workspace_member_scopes; that policy omits workspace_member_scopes_select_own's is_active_member conjunct, so it is wider than what authenticated holds, and reaches nothing because only app_authz's helpers, which ask is_active_member first, can use it (A1 F6).
migration_and_data_impact: No migration and no data change. The manifest gains one writable path and one net amendment path, so the 33 line pins in db/foundation/lint/audit-coverage-map.json move +2 (open_blockers[i] on line 257+i); open_blockers[199] is added at the end.
